item.title: Trial of Massachusetts mother accused of killing her three children enters second week
House Ethics panel recommends censure for GOP lawmaker in harassment case
item.description: The House Ethics Committee has issued a report on its investigation into Rep. Chuck Edwards, finding substantial evidence of misconduct.

item.title: No new talks scheduled despite Trump's remarks, U.S. officials say
item.description: President Trump called Tehran "unbelievably duplicitous" and described the negotiations as Iran's "last chance" to reach a deal and prevent escalation.

item.title: Taylor Farms in spotlight amid cyclospora outbreak
item.description: The largest recent cyclospora outbreak in the U.S. has brought renewed attention to one of the country's biggest produce suppliers.
